name: datto-saas-protection-mcp
description: MCP server for Datto SaaS Protection (Backupify) - read M365/GWS backup posture, seats and license usage through AI assistants
long_description: Provides AI assistants with read-only, structured access to your Datto SaaS Protection (Backupify) tenant. List the customers and protected domains your API key covers, browse seats for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, pull per-customer backup and storage reports, and review the partner portal activity log and seat usage through the Model Context Protocol.

datto_saas_public_key.title: Datto SaaS Public Key
datto_saas_public_key.description: Public API key from Partner Portal > Admin > Integrations > API Keys

datto_saas_secret_key.title: Datto SaaS Secret Key
datto_saas_secret_key.description: Secret API key from Partner Portal > Admin > Integrations > API Keys
